children.doc: /** 🧾️ InkCanvasHost model: the ink document, item, event and gesture types and the scene and selection id parsers. */

/** 📐️ InkCanvasHost geometry: the host id counter, the world snapping, the screen and world conversion, the item and selection bounds, the resize and scale math, the hit tests and the stroke erasure. */

/** 🌳️ InkCanvasHost document operations: the text and html conversion of paragraphs, the clipboard payload, the item cloning and creation by kind and the local application of canvas events to the item tree. */
/** 🧱️ InkCanvasHost block views: the math renderer port with its KaTeX default and the text, table, image, math and stroke block views. */
/** 🪟️ InkCanvasHost overlays: the selection chrome with its resize handles, the viewport grid and the text and table cell editor overlays. */
/** 🧲️ InkCanvasHost state shapes: the drag, text edit and table edit state types and the host constants. */
